exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by 100-g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) with Carpenter-Coustan criteria
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by 50-g glucose challenge test (GCT) ≥ 200 mg/dl
outcome: Large for gestational age (LGA) neonate (> 90th percentile)
cohort: 970 women with GDM who delivered at Siriraj Hospital, Thailand, between July 2015 and April 2018.
finding: There were no significant differences in pregnancy and neonatal outcomes between women with GDM diagnosed by a 50-g GCT ≥ 200 mg/dl and those diagnosed by 100-g OGTT with Carpenter-Coustan criteria, although gestational age at diagnosis was earlier in the 50-g GCT group.
